integrity: Fourier theorem proved for all admissible parameters. Exact rational qutrit certificate provided. Finite numeric consistency tests are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact qubit formula only; qutrit and higher-state lower bound is not claimed optimal; finite-scale gap, not an asymptotic scaling separation. Previously published Hilbert Fourier analyses use a related method but a different increment law.
title: Exact qubit metric-cotype constants and a three-level trace-distance separation
